issues.description: Element: public method on class Farm. The problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 112-116) and the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 9) require a public method named singFarmSong() that plays the farm song. The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java line 59) instead provides a public method named playFarmSong() which implements the expected behavior. This name mismatch means the solution does not expose the method name students and automated graders will look for (singFarmSong), causing confusion and potential test or comparison failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Best fix: rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to public void singFarmSong() (keeping its implementation and calling the existing private singFarmSongVerse(Animal) loop). Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to require playFarmSong(), but prefer renaming the solution to singFarmSong() so the reference implementation matches the exercise specification and automated checks.
